name: imisic
description: Ivan Misic's Claude Code tools: senior-review lenses, skills, and workflow commands.

plugins.name: role-lenses
plugins.description: Get a pointed second opinion instead of agreement. Eight reviewer roles (product, design, architecture, engineering, operations, security, testing, and a red-team critic) each check one thing hard.

plugins.name: dev-workflow-forge
plugins.description: Generate a code review skill and coding rules fitted to your own repository, then improve them from what your reviews keep finding. Every proposed change waits for your approval.

plugins.name: dev-loop
plugins.description: Three commands for the daily loop in Claude Code: fix a bug or apply a review report, commit with pre-flight checks, or run review, fix and commit as one flow, pausing after the review for your go-ahead.

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Review and revise writing, code and websites that read as generic AI output. Three scanners for prose, source code and web design, guidance for what a scanner can't see, and a method for building a voice profile from your own writing.

plugins.name: sanitize-public
plugins.description: Check a repository, plugin or download for credentials and private details before it goes public. Scans the files and the full Git history, matches your own private names in any spelling, and walks a checklist for leaks a scanner can't see.

plugins.name: search-visibility
plugins.description: For website owners and marketers: turn Google Search Console data into a ranked list of SEO fixes, and check whether AI assistants can find, read and cite your site.
